description: This file defines a custom exception class MiniLangException for the Mini-language component of the OFBiz project. It extends a general exception class and provides multiple constructors for different error reporting scenarios.

classes.name: MiniLangException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating errors in the Mini-language processing, extending the GeneralException base class.

methods.name: MiniLangException()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates a new instance with no detail message.

methods.name: MiniLangException(String str)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a detail message describing the exception.

methods.name: MiniLangException(String str, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a detail message and a nested cause.

methods.name: MiniLangException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a nested cause.
